baseline.historical_result: J7 near-degenerate global case FAIL; preserved without mutation

hypothesis: The archived J7 near-degenerate result is the exact historical FAIL object whose canonical LF digest is 0707… and whose current raw Windows-checkout digest is 558b…. Binding the raw digest explicitly should allow the already frozen interior-node sweep to proceed past input integrity checks without changing the archived file or any mechanical criterion.

inputs.source_sha_convention: raw SHA-256 for binary and preserved JSON files; canonical LF SHA-256 only where the contract key explicitly says canonical

model.element: HEX8-SRI with the same corrected source used in J7

geometry.input: coordinates and connectivity loaded directly from the archived J7 state NPZ
geometry.mesh: 4 x 2 x 2, 45 nodes, 16 elements, 135 total DOFs, 27 fixed and 108 free DOFs
geometry.boundary_condition: all three translations fixed on the archived x=0 face

model.load: the archived J7 force vector reused bit-for-bit; equal negative-Z forces on the nine nodes at x=L; resultant (0,0,-1) N

one_factor_transformation.only_changed_parameter: z coordinates of these three interior nodes

model.thickness_note: 0.04 m is the top-to-bottom coordinate separation at fixed x,y. The 0.046 m z bounding-box range includes the existing skew of the exterior surfaces.

pre_execution_geometry_check.requirements: all Gauss Jacobians finite/positive; exterior coordinates bitwise unchanged; outer bounding box unchanged

indicators.free_residual: r_f = (K u - F)_f; report ||r_f||, ||r_f||/max(||F||,1), and backward error ||r_f||/(||K||_F ||u|| + ||F||)
indicators.reactions: R is set to the constrained components of K u - F; force and moment residuals are then recomputed from nodal vectors
indicators.energy: report U=0.5 uᵀKu and W=0.5 uᵀF with both |U-W|/max(|U|,|W|) and the historical J7 denominator max(|W|,1 J)
indicators.second_solver: scipy.linalg.solve(assume_a='sym') on the same Kff and Ff, compared to numpy.linalg.solve; this is a solver-method check, not an independent formulation
indicators.alpha_zero_replay: compare reassembled K and solution against the archived J7 state; relative reproducibility bounds 1e-12 and 1e-10 respectively

reference_and_claim_limits.available_reference: archived J7 alpha=0 matrix and displacement for reproducibility; force, moment and energy identities for internal equilibrium
reference_and_claim_limits.independent_continuum_reference: not established for this near-degenerate global cantilever
reference_and_claim_limits.external_solver: Code_Aster and CalculiX are unavailable in the current environment
reference_and_claim_limits.interpretation: The α sweep isolates the effect of this interior-node mapping on the same discretized linear model. It cannot by itself explain J7 failures or prove physical accuracy.

criteria.formal_acceptance_thresholds: none; residual, closure, energy, condition number and displacement trends are descriptive indicators
completion_invariants: unchanged exterior geometry and archived force/support vectors
alpha=0 reproduces the archived J7 matrix/state within its frozen replay bounds

execution.budget_semantics: timeout and captured-output caps are enforced by the launcher; RSS/process/temp/archive/free-space are sampled or soft controls, not OS quotas
execution.preflight: one exact-node pytest collect-only receipt required before the attempt

preservation.first_harness_failure: preserved as PYTEST_FAILED; this corrective contract creates a separate attempt and does not rewrite the earlier trace
preservation.attempt_001: PYTEST_FAILED before FEM on contract key mismatch; unchanged
preservation.attempt_002: PYTEST_FAILED before FEM on raw/canonical historical-result SHA mismatch; unchanged

lineage.prior_attempt_scope: failed during pre-assembly integrity validation; code compared raw file bytes to a SHA-256 value that was the Git-canonical LF digest; no stiffness assembly, solve, or post-processing occurred
lineage.source_change_classification: create a distinct contract binding the actual raw input digest and an explicit unit-level integrity test; preserve the historical J7 FAIL object and source file unchanged
